`split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n315\t/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n316\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n317\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n318\t/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n319\t/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n320\t/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n321\t///\n322\t/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n323\t/// statement terminators.\n324\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n325\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n326\t    let len = bytes.len();\n327\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n328\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n329\t    let mut i = 0;\n330\t\n331\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n332\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n333\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n334\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n335\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n336\t\n337\t    while i < len {\n338\t        let b = bytes[i];\n339\t\n340\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n341\t        if in_line_comment {\n342\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n343\t                in_line_comment = false;\n344\t            }\n345\t            i += 1;\n346\t            continue;\n347\t        }\n348\t\n349\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n350\t        if in_block_comment {\n351\t            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n352\t                in_block_comment = false;\n353\t                i += 2;\n354\t            } else {\n355\t                i += 1;\n356\t            }\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n361\t        if in_single_quote {\n362\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n363\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n364\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n365\t                    i += 2;\n366\t                } else {\n367\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n368\t                    i += 1;\n369\t                }\n370\t            } else {\n371\t                i += 1;\n372\t            }\n373\t            continue;\n374\t        }\n375\t\n376\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n377\t        if in_double_quote {\n378\t            if b == b'\"' {\n379\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n380\t                    i += 2;\n381\t                } else {\n382\t                    in_double_quote = false;\n383\t                    i += 1;\n384\t                }\n385\t            } else {\n386\t                i += 1;\n387\t            }\n388\t            continue;\n389\t        }\n390\t\n391\t        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n392\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n393\t            in_single_quote = true;\n394\t            i += 1;\n395\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n396\t            in_double_quote = true;\n397\t            i += 1;\n398\t        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n399\t            in_line_comment = true;\n400\t            i += 2;\n401\t        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n402\t            in_block_comment = true;\n403\t            i += 2;\n404\t        } else if b == b';' {\n405\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n406\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n407\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n408\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n409\t            }\n410\t            start = i + 1;\n411\t            i += 1;\n412\t        } else {\n413\t            i += 1;\n414\t        }\n415\t    }\n416\t\n417\t    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n418\t    if start < len {\n419\t        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n420\t        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n421\t            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n422\t        }\n423\t    }\n424\t\n425\t    stmts\n426\t}\n427\t\n428\t/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\n429\tfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n430\t    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n431\t    Ok(())\n432\t}\n433\t\n434\tpub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n435\t    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n436\t    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n437\t    Ok(())\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n441\t/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\n442\tfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n443\t    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n444\t    // Old format: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n445\t    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n446\t    let has_es: bool = conn.query_row(\n447\t        \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('critical_path_cache') WHERE !has_closed_at {\n499\t        conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN closed_at DATETIME\", [])?;\n500\t        conn.execute(\"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN duration_seconds INTEGER\", [])?;\n501\t    }\n502\t\n503\t    Ok(())\n504\t}\n505\t\n506\tpub fn ensure_wal_mode(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n507\t    // Use execute_batch so PRAGMAs that return rows don't cause errors\n508\t    conn.execute_batch(\n509\t        \"PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\n510\t         PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n511\t         PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000;\n512\t         PRAGMA Ok(())\n516\t}\n517\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bb357e64-08f7-489e-9f32-077d103f46df","uuid":"4cdd79d2-02cd-4dd4-bc8f-d98f65dfec65","timestamp":"2026-05-08T18:14:34.523Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/coding/bead-forge/src/storage/schema.rs","content":"//! identifiers, and comments.\n///\n/// A naive `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n///\n/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n/// statement terminators.\nfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n    let len = bytes.len();\n    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n    let mut i = 0;\n\n    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n\n    while i < len {\n        let b = bytes[i];\n\n        // --- Line comment state ---\n        if in_line_comment {\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                in_line_comment = false;\n            }\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Block comment state ---\n        if in_block_comment {\n            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n                in_block_comment = false;\n                i += 2;\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n        if in_single_quote {\n            if b == b'\\'' {\n                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_single_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n        if in_double_quote {\n            if b == b'\"' {\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_double_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n        if b == b'\\'' {\n            in_single_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'\"' {\n            in_double_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n            in_line_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n            in_block_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b';' {\n            // Statement terminator at top level.\n            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n            }\n            start = i + 1;\n            i += 1;\n        } else {\n            i += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n    if start < len {\n        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    stmts\n}\n\n/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\nfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\nfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n    // Old format: Critical path computation for dependency DAGs.\n//!\n//! This module implements a two-pass algorithm to compute float (slack) for each bead:\n//! - Forward pass: compute earliest start (ES) - number of hops from root\n//! - Backward pass: compute latest start (LS)\n//! - Float = LS - ES (zero float = critical path)\n//!\n//! The critical path cache is used by claim scoring to prioritize beads that block\n//! the longest chain of work.\n//!\n//! Note: SQLite does not support aggregate functions (MAX, MIN, GROUP BY) in the\n//! recursive part of a recursive CTE. Therefore, this implementation uses temporary\n//! tables with iterative computation, which achieves the same result.\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\nuse rusqlite::{params, Connection};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n\n/// Result of critical path computation for an epic.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct CriticalPathResult {\n    /// The epic (root) bead ID\n    pub epic_id: String,\n    /// All beads in the epic with their float values\n    pub beads: Vec<BeadFloat>,\n    /// Longest chain of bead IDs from root to leaf\n    pub longest_chain: Vec<String>,\n    /// Minimum number of bead completions on critical path\n    pub min_remaining: i64,\n}\n\n/// Float information for a single bead.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct BeadFloat {\n    pub bead_id: String,\n    pub epic_id: Option<String>,\n    pub es: i64,  // earliest start\n    pub ls: i64,  // latest start\n    pub float: i64,  // ls - es\n}\n\n/// Invalidate the critical path cache.\n///\n/// Call this when the dependency graph changes (add/remove dependencies,\n/// status changes that affect the graph).\npub fn invalidate_cache(tx: &Connection) -> Result<()> {\n    tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM critical_path_cache\", [])?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Compute critical path for all beads in the dependency graph.\n///\n/// This performs a two-pass walk:\n/// 1. Forward pass: compute ES (earliest start) from roots to leaves\n/// 2. Backward pass: compute LS (latest start) from leaves to roots\n/// 3. Float = LS - ES (zero float beads are on critical path)\n///\n/// The results are cached in the critical_path_cache table for use by\n/// claim scoring.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `tx` - The transaction to use\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(CriticalPathResult)` - Aggregated results with beads, longest chain, and min remaining\npub fn compute_all_critical_paths(tx: &Connection) -> Result<CriticalPathResult> {\n    // Create temporary tables for the computation\n    tx.execute(\n        \"CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_forward (bead_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, es INTEGER)\",\n        [],\n    )?;\n    tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM temp_forward\", [])?;\n\n    tx.execute(\n        \"CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temp_backward (bead_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, ls INTEGER)\",\n        [],\n    )?;\n    tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM temp_backward\", [])?;\n\n    // Forward pass: iterative computation of ES\n    // Initialize roots (beads with no open blocking predecessors) with ES = 0\n    // A root has no incoming blocking dependencies from open issues\n    tx.execute(\n        r#\"\n        INSERT INTO temp_forward (bead_id, es)\n        SELECT DISTINCT i.id, 0\n        FROM issues i\n        WHERE i.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')\n          AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n          AND NOT EXISTS (\n              SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d\n              JOIN issues pred ON pred.id = d.depends_on_id\n              WHERE d.issue_id = i.id\n                AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                AND pred.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')\n          )\n        \"#,\n        [],\n    )?;\n\n    // Iteratively compute ES for dependent beads\n    // Keep going until no more beads can be computed\n    let mut max_iterations = 1000; // Safety limit\n    let mut iteration = 0;\n    loop {\n        iteration += 1;\n        if iteration > max_iterations {\n            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"Forward pass: too many iterations, possible cycle\"));\n        }\n\n        // Find beads whose all predecessors are already computed\n        // For each bead, ES = max(ES of all predecessors) + 1\n        let affected = tx.execute(\n            r#\"\n            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp_forward (bead_id, es)\n            SELECT d.issue_id, MAX(f.es) + 1\n            FROM dependencies d\n            INNER JOIN temp_forward f ON f.bead_id = d.depends_on_id\n            WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temp_forward tf WHERE tf.bead_id = d.issue_id)\n              AND NOT EXISTS (\n                  -- Check if all predecessors are computed\n                  SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d2\n                  WHERE d2.issue_id = d.issue_id\n                    AND d2.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temp_forward tf WHERE tf.bead_id = d2.depends_on_id)\n              )\n            GROUP BY d.issue_id\n            \"#,\n            [],\n        )?;\n        if affected == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Backward pass: compute LS (latest start)\n    // Initialize leaves (beads with no open dependents) with LS = ES\n    // A leaf has no outgoing blocking dependencies to open issues\n    tx.execute(\n        r#\"\n        INSERT INTO temp_backward (bead_id, ls)\n        SELECT DISTINCT f.bead_id, f.es\n        FROM temp_forward f\n        WHERE NOT EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d\n            INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.issue_id\n            WHERE d.depends_on_id = f.bead_id\n              AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n              AND i.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')\n        )\n        \"#,\n        [],\n    )?;\n\n    // Iteratively compute LS for beads whose all successors are computed\n    // For each bead, LS = min(LS of all successors) - 1\n    // Using MIN (not MAX) because we want the latest time we can start\n    // without delaying ANY successor - we take the most constrained one\n    iteration = 0;\n    loop {\n        iteration += 1;\n        if iteration > max_iterations {\n            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"Backward pass: too many iterations, possible cycle\"));\n        }\n\n        let affected = tx.execute(\n            r#\"\n            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp_backward (bead_id, ls)\n            SELECT f.bead_id, MIN(b.ls) - 1\n            FROM temp_forward f\n            INNER JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = f.bead_id\n            INNER JOIN temp_backward b ON b.bead_id = d.issue_id\n            WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temp_backward tb WHERE tb.bead_id = f.bead_id)\n              AND NOT EXISTS (\n                  -- Check if all successors are computed\n                  SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d2\n                  WHERE d2.depends_on_id = f.bead_id\n                    AND d2.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM temp_backward tb WHERE tb.bead_id = d2.issue_id)\n              )\n            GROUP BY f.bead_id\n            \"#,\n            [],\n        )?;\n        if affected == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute float and populate critical_path_cache\n    // Float = LS - ES (zero means on critical path)\n    tx.execute(\n        r#\"\n        INSERT INTO critical_path_cache (bead_id, epic_id, es, ls, float, updated_at)\n        SELECT\n            f.bead_id,\n            NULL as epic_id,\n            f.es,\n            COALESCE(b.ls, f.es) as ls,\n            COALESCE(b.ls, f.es) - f.es as float,\n            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        FROM temp_forward f\n        LEFT JOIN temp_backward b ON b.bead_id = f.bead_id\n        ON CONFLICT(bead_id) DO UPDATE SET\n            epic_id = excluded.epic_id,\n            es = excluded.es,\n            ls = excluded.ls,\n            float = excluded.float,\n            updated_at = excluded.updated_at\n        \"#,\n        [],\n    )?;\n\n    // Query results for return\n    let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n        \"SELECT bead_id, epic_id, es, ls, float FROM critical_path_cache ORDER BY float ASC, es ASC\",\n    )?;\n    let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n    let mut beads = Vec::new();\n    let mut max_es = 0i64;\n    let mut critical_beads: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n        let bead_id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        let es: i64 = row.get(2)?;\n        let float: i64 = row.get(4)?;\n\n        if es > max_es {\n            max_es = es;\n        }\n\n        if float == 0 {\n            critical_beads.push(bead_id.clone());\n        }\n\n        beads.push(BeadFloat {\n            bead_id,\n            epic_id: row.get(1)?,\n            es,\n            ls: row.get(3)?,\n            float,\n        });\n    }\n    drop(rows);\n    drop(stmt);\n\n    // Find the longest chain by tracing back from the leaf with max ES\n    let longest_chain = find_longest_chain(tx, &critical_beads)?;\n\n    // Minimum remaining is the length of the critical path (max ES + 1)\n    let min_remaining = max_es + 1;\n\n    Ok(CriticalPathResult {\n        epic_id: \"all\".to_string(),\n        beads,\n        longest_chain,\n        min_remaining,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Find the longest chain through critical path beads.\n///\n/// Traces back from leaves to root through zero-float beads.\nfn find_longest_chain(\n    tx: &Connection,\n    critical_beads: &[String],\n) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n    if critical_beads.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(Vec::new());\n    }\n\n    let critical_set: std::collections::HashSet<&String> =\n        critical_beads.iter().collect();\n\n    // Find leaf beads (zero float, no blocking dependents or dependents are closed)\n    let mut leaf_candidates: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for bead_id in critical_beads {\n        let has_open_dependents: bool = tx.query_row(\n            r#\"\n            SELECT EXISTS(\n                SELECT 1 FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.issue_id\n                WHERE d.depends_on_id = ?1\n                  AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                  AND i.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')\n            )\n            \"#,\n            params![bead_id],\n            |row| row.get(0),\n        )?;\n        if !has_open_dependents {\n            leaf_candidates.push(bead_id.clone());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Pick a leaf and trace back to root\n    if let Some(leaf) = leaf_candidates.first() {\n        let mut chain = Vec::new();\n        let mut current = leaf.clone();\n\n        loop {\n            chain.push(current.clone());\n\n            // Find a zero-float dependency (predecessor)\n            let mut found_dep = None;\n            let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n                r#\"\n                SELECT d.depends_on_id\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = d.depends_on_id\n                WHERE d.issue_id = ?1\n                  AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                  AND c.float = 0\n                ORDER BY c.es DESC\n                LIMIT 1\n                \"#\n            )?;\n            let mut rows = stmt.query(params![&current])?;\n            if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n                let dep_id: String = row.get(0)?;\n                if critical_set.contains(&dep_id) {\n                    found_dep = Some(dep_id);\n                }\n            }\n            drop(rows);\n            drop(stmt);\n\n            match found_dep {\n                Some(dep) => current = dep,\n                None => break,\n            }\n        }\n\n        chain.reverse();\n        Ok(chain)\n    } else {\n        Ok(Vec::new())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Compute critical path for a single epic (root bead and all descendants).\n///\n/// This computes the critical path for the dependency subtree rooted at the given bead ID.\n/// The result includes all beads in the epic with their float values.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `tx` - The transaction to use\n/// * `epic_id` - The root bead ID (the \"epic\")\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(CriticalPathResult)` - Results for this epic\npub fn compute_epic_critical_path(tx: &Connection, epic_id: &str) -> Result<CriticalPathResult> {\n    // First, check if cache is populated. If not, compute all paths.\n    let cache_count: i64 = tx.query_row(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM critical_path_cache\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n    if cache_count == 0 {\n        compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n    }\n\n    // Query beads in this epic (descendants of the root)\n    // For now, we return all beads since we don't have a true epic hierarchy\n    let mut stmt = tx.prepare(\n        \"SELECT bead_id, epic_id, es, ls, float FROM critical_path_cache ORDER BY float ASC, es ASC\",\n    )?;\n    let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n    let mut beads = Vec::new();\n    let mut max_es = 0i64;\n    let mut critical_beads: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n        let bead_id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        let es: i64 =    }\n\n        beads.push(BeadFloat {\n            bead_id,\n            epic_id: row.get(1)?,\n            es,\n            ls: row.get(3)?,\n            float,\n        });\n    }\n    drop(rows);\n    drop(stmt);\n\n    // Find the longest chain\n    let longest_chain = find_longest_chain(tx, &critical_beads)?;\n\n    let min_remaining = max_es + 1;\n\n    Ok(CriticalPathResult {\n Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            })\n        })\n    }\n\n\n    pub fn sync_to_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path, dirty_only: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n        if dirty_only {\n            let result = export_jsonl_dirty(jsonl_path, || self.list_dirty_issues(), || self.clear_dirty())?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        } else {\n            let result = export_jsonl(jsonl_path, || self.list_all_issues())?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_issue_conn(conn: &Connection, row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Issue> {\n        let status_str: String = row.get(7)?;\n        let type_str: String = since: Option<&DateTime<Utc>>,\n        actor: Option<&str>,\n        event_type: Option<&EventType>,\n        limit: Option<usize>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n\n        if let Some(id) = issue_id {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND issue_id = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(dt) = since {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND created_at >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(a.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(et) = event_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND event_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(et.as_str().to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY created_at ASC\");\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", l));\n        }\n\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Event> {\n        let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n        Ok(Event {\n            id: row.get(0)?,\n            issue_id: Option<&str>, labels: &[String], priority_min: Option<i32>, priority_max: Option<i32>, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<Issue>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT DISTINCT i.id, i.content_hash, i.title, i.description, i.design, i.acceptance_criteria, i.notes,\n                    i.status, i.priority, i.issue_type, i.assignee, i.owner, i.estimated_minutes,\n                    i.created_at, i.created_by, i.updated_at, i.closed_at, i.close_reason,\n                    i.closed_by_session, i.due_at, i.defer_until, i.external_ref, i.source_system,\n                    i.source_repo, i.deleted_at, i.deleted_by, i.delete_reason, i.original_type,\n                    i.compaction_level, i.compacted_at, i.compacted_at_commit, i.original_size,\n                    i.sender, i.ephemeral, i.pinned, i.is_template\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN labels l ON i.id = l.issue_id\n             WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n        if let Some(q) = query {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND (i.title LIKE ?{} OR i.description LIKE ?{})\", param_idx, param_idx + 1));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            params.push(format!(\"%{}%\", q));\n            param_idx += 2;\n        }\n        for s in status {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.status = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(s.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        for t in issue_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.issue_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(t.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = assignee {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.assignee = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(a.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if !labels.is_empty() {\n            let label_conditions: Vec<String> = labels.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, _)| format!(\"l.label = ?{}\", param_idx + i)).collect();\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND ({}) \", label_conditions.join(\" OR \")));\n            for label in labels {\n                params.push(label.clone());\n                param_idx += 1;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(min) = priority_min {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(min.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(max) = priority_max {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND i.priority <= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(max.to_string());\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY i.priority ASC, i.created_at ASC\");\n        if limit > 0 {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", limit));\n        }\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p as &dyn rusqlite::ToSql).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut issues = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            issues.push(Self::row_to_issue_conn(&conn, row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(issues)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<Stats> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let total: i64 = conn.query_row(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE deleted_at IS NULL\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n        let open: i64 = conn.query_row(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues WHERE status = 'open' AND deleted_at IS NULL\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n        let in_progress: i64 = })\n    }\n\n    /// Get the score of the top candidate bead for claiming.\n    ///\n    /// Returns None if no candidates are available.\n    /// Used by claim_any() for cross-workspace scoring comparison.\n    ///\n    /// Note: critical_float is the raw float value (lower = more critical).\n    /// The claim scoring uses 1000.0 / (float + 1) as a bonus, which is\n    /// monotonically decreasing with float. Therefore, ordering by float ASC\n    /// is equivalent to ordering by bonus DESC.\n    pub fn top_candidate_score(&self) -> Result<Option<crate::claim::Score>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(d.issue_id), 0) as downstream_impact,\n                    COALESCE(c.float, 999) as critical_float,\n                    i.priority,\n                    strftime('%s', i.created_at) as created_ts\n             FROM issues i\n             LEFT JOIN dependencies d ON d.depends_on_id = i.id AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n             LEFT JOIN critical_path_cache c ON c.bead_id = i.id\n             WHERE i.status = 'open'\n               AND i.ephemeral = 0\n               AND i.pinned = 0\n               AND i.is_template = 0\n               AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n               AND NOT EXISTS (\n                   SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n                   INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n                   WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n                   AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                   AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n               )\n             GROUP BY i.id\n             ORDER BY\n                 downstream_impact DESC,\n                 critical_float ASC,\n                 i.priority ASC,\n                 i.created_at ASC\n             LIMIT 1\",\n        )?;\n\n        let mut rows = stmt.query([])?;\n        if let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            Ok(Some(crate::claim::Score {\n                downstream_impact: row.get(0)?,\n                critical_float: row.get(1)?,\n                priority: row.get(2)?,\n                created_at_ts: row.get(3)?,\n            }))\n        } else {\n            Ok(None)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a worker     } else {\n            Ok(None)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create an issue within a transaction context.\n    pub fn create_issue_tx(tx: &Connection, issue: &Issue) -> Result<()> {\n      max_depth: usize,\n    },\n}\n\n#[derive(Subcommand)]\npub enum LabelCommands {\n    /// Add label(s) to an issue\n    Add {\n        /// Label(s) to add (multiple labels supported)\n Result<Cli> {\n    Ok(Cli::try_parse()?)\n}\n\npub fn run(cli: Cli) -> Result<()> {\n    let workspace = cli.workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\".\"));\n\n    // For init command, we allow the .beads directory to not exist yet\n    match &cli.command {\n        Commands::Init { .. } => {\n            let beads_dir = workspace.join(\".beads\");\n            return match cli.command {\n                Commands::Init { prefix } => cmd_init(&beads_dir, &prefix),\n                _ => unreachable!(),\n            };\n        }\n        _ => {}\n    }\n\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(&workspace)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace))?;\n\n    match cli.command {\n        Commands::Init { prefix } => cmd_init(&beads_dir, &prefix),\n        Commands::Create { title, type_, priority, description, assignee, label } => {\n            cmd_create(&beads_dir, title, type_, priority, description, assignee, label)\n        }\n        Commands::List { status, type_, assignee, priority, limit, all, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_list(&beads_dir, status, type_, assignee, priority, limit, all, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Show { id, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_show(&beads_dir, &id, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Update { id, title, status, priority, assignee } => {\n            cmd_update(&beads_dir, &id, title, status, priority, assignee)\n        }\n        Commands::Close { id, reason } => cmd_close(&beads_dir, &id, &reason),\n        Commands::Reopen { id } => cmd_reopen(&beads_dir, &id),\n        Commands::Delete { id } => cmd_delete(&beads_dir, &id),\n        Commands::Ready { limit, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_ready(&beads_dir, limit, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Claim { assignee, model, harness, harness_version, any, fallback, workspace_paths, dry_run, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { Commands::Sync { flush_only, import_only } => cmd_sync(&beads_dir, flush_only, import_only),\n        Commands::Doctor { repair } => cmd_doctor(&beads_dir, repair),\n        Commands::Count { status } => cmd_count(&beads_dir, status),\n        Commands::Batch { file, json, stdin } => cmd_batch(&beads_dir, file, json, stdin),\n        Commands::Mitosis { id, children, reason, format } => cmd_search(&beads_dir, query, status, type_, assignee, label, priority_min, priority_max, limit, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Stats { by_type, by_priority, by_assignee, by_label, format } => {\n            cmd_stats(&beads_dir, by_type, by_priority, by_assignee, by_label, &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Schema { target, format } => cmd_schema(&target, &format),\n        Commands::Config(config) => cmd_config(&beads_dir, config),\n        Commands::Velocity { model, harness, format } => cmd_velocity(&beads_dir, model, harness, &format),\n        Commands::Labels { id, format } => cmd_labels(&beads_dir, &id, &format),\n        Commands::Annotate(annotate) => cmd_annotate(&beads_dir, annotate),\n        Commands::Log { id, limit, since, actor, status_changes, diff,     Commands::CriticalPath { id, max_depth, format } => cmd_critical_path(&beads_dir, &id, max_depth, &format),\n        Commands::Rotate { days, dry_run } => cmd_rotate(&beads_dir, days, dry_run),\n        Commands::Migrate { workspace, from_jsonl, seed_velocity, dry_run, skip_verify } => {\n            cmd_migrate(&beads_dir, workspace, from_jsonl, seed_velocity, dry_run, skip_verify)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn cmd_init(beads_dir: &PathBuf, prefix: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(beads_dir)?;\n\n    let config_path = beads_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !config_path.exists() {\n        let config = format!(\n            r#\"issue_prefixes: [{}]\ndefault_priority: 2\ndefault_type: task\nclaim_ttl_minutes: 30\n\"#,\n            prefix\n        );\n        std::fs::write(&config_path, config)?;\n    }\n\n    let metadata_path = beads_dir.join(\"metadata.json\");\n    if !metadata_path.exists() {\n        let metadata = r#\"{\"database\": \"beads.db\", \"jsonl_export\": \"issues.jsonl\"}\"#;\n        std::fs::write(&metadata_path, metadata)?;\n    }\n\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(\"beads.db\");\n    let _storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let gitignore_path = beads_dir.join(\".gitignore\");\n    if !gitignore_path.exists() {\n        std::fs::write(&gitignore_path, \"beads.db\\nbeads.db-shm\\nbeads.db-wal\\n\")?;\n    }\n\n    println!(\"Initialized bead-forge workspace in {:?}\", beads_dir);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n    let id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n\n    let mut issue = Issue::new(id.clone(), title, \".\".to_string());\n    issue.issue_type = IssueType::from_str(type_.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n    issue.priority = Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n    issue.assignee = assignee;\n    issue.labels = labels;\n\n    storage.create_issue(&issue)?;\n\n    println!(\"{}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type = Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let issue = match storage.get_issue(id)? {\n        Some(i) => i,\n        None => {\n            // Search archives\n            find_bead_in_archives(beads_dir, id)?\n                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id))?\n        }\n    };\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Strip dependencies/comments before serializing: NEEDLE's BrDependency\n            // format ({id, title, status, priority, dependency_type}) differs from\n            // bead-forge's Dependency format ({issue_id, depends_on_id, type, ...}).\n            // NEEDLE has #[serde(default)] on the deps field so empty is fine.\n            let mut out = issue;\n            out.dependencies = vec![];\n            out.comments = vec![];\n            // Wrap in array so NEEDLE's parse_single_bead (Vec<Bead> → first) works.\n            println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&vec![out])?);\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            println!(\"ID: {}\", issue.id);\n            println!(\"Title: {}\", issue.title);\n            println!(\"Status: {}\", issue.status);\n            println!(\"Priority: {}\", issue.priority);\n            println!(\"Type: {}\", issue.issue_type);\n            if let Some(desc) = &issue.description {\n                println!(\"Description: {}\", desc);\n            }\n            if let Some(assignee) = &issue.assignee {\n                println!(\"Assignee: {}\", assignee);\n            }\n            if !issue.labels.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"Labels: {}\", issue.labels.join(\", \"));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_update(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    id: &str,\n    title: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let cmd_reopen(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage =     Ok(())\n    })?;\n\n    println!(\"Deleted bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        get_ready_candidates(tx, limit)\n    })?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string(&candidate)?);\n            }\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"{}\", crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                    &candidate.id,\n                    &candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float,\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id, candidate.title, candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact, candidate.critical_float);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: bool,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) = local_storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n                            get_ready_candidates(tx, 1)\n                        }) {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = (a.1.downstream_impact, a.1.priority, a.1.created_at.clone());\n                score_a.cmp(&score_b)\n            });\n            all_candidates.into_iter().take(1).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Single workspace dry run\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let candidates = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n                get_ready_candidates(tx, 1)\n            })?;\n            candidates.into_iter().map(|c| (beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir).to_path_buf(), c)).collect()\n        };\n\n        if let Some((path, candidate)) = candidates.first() {\n            match format {\n                \"json\" => {\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"bead_id\": candidate.id,\n                        \"title\": candidate.title,\n                        \"priority\": candidate.priority,\n                        \"downstream_impact\": candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        \"assignee\": assignee,\n                        \"workspace\": path.display().to_string(),\n                        \"dry_run\": true\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", output);\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    println!(\"{} (priority={}, impact={}, workspace={})\",\n                        candidate.id, candidate.priority, candidate.downstream_impact, path.display());\n                }\n            }\n        } else if format == \"json\" {\n            println!(\"{{}}\");\n        } else {\n            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n        }\n    } else if any {\n        // Claim from any workspace\n        let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n            // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n            find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n        } else {\n            workspace_paths.to_vec()\n        };\n\n        let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult { bead_id, reclaimed, workspace_path }) => {\n                match format {\n                    \"json\" => {\n                        let output = serde_json::json!({\n                            \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                            \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                            \"assignee\": assignee,\n                            \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                        });\n                        println!(\"{}\", output);\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n                            println!(\"{} (workspace: {})\", bead_id, path.display());\n                        } else {\n                            println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            None => {\n                if format == \"json\" {\n                    println!(\"{{}}\");\n                } else {\n                    println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    } else if fallback {\n        // Fallback mode: try current workspace first, then any\n        let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n        let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n        let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            claim(tx, assignee, claim_ttl, Utc::now(), Some(&worker_metadata))\n        })?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult { bead_id, reclaimed, .. }) => {\n                match format {\n                    \"json\" => {\n                        let output = serde_json::json!({\n                            \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                            \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                            \"assignee\": assignee\n                        });\n                        println!(\"{}\", output);\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            None => {\n                // Fallback to any workspace\n                let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                    find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n                } else {\n                    workspace_paths.to_vec()\n                };\n\n                let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, claim_ttl, Some(&worker_metadata))?;\n\n                match result {\n                    Some(ClaimResult { bead_id, reclaimed, workspace_path }) => {\n                        match format {\n                            \"json\" => {\n                                let output = serde_json::json!({\n                                    \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                                    \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                                    \"assignee\": assignee,\n                                    \"workspace\": workspace_path.map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                                });\n                                println!(\"{}\", output);\n                            }\n                            _ => {\n                                if let Some(path) = workspace_path {\n                                    println!(\"{} (workspace: {})\", bead_id, path.display());\n                                } else {\n                                    println!(\"{}\", bead_id);\n                                }\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None => {\n                        if format == \"json\" {\n                            println!(\"{{}}\");\n                        } else {\n                            println!(\"No beads available to claim\");\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Normal single-workspace claim\n        let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n        let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n        let result = storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            claim(tx, assignee, claim_ttl, Utc::now(), Some(&worker_metadata))\n        })?;\n\n        match result {\n            Some(ClaimResult { bead_id, reclaimed, .. }) => {\n                match format {\n                    \"json\" => {\n                        let output = serde_json::json!({\n                            \"bead_id\": bead_id,\n                            \"reclaimed\": reclaimed,\n                            \"assignee\": assignee\n                        });\n                        println!(\"{}\", output);\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        println!(\"{}\", i.status = 'open'\n           AND i.ephemeral = 0\n           AND i.pinned = 0\n           AND i.is_template = 0\n           AND i.deleted_at IS NULL\n           AND NOT EXISTS (\n               SELECT 1 FROM dependencies blocker_dep\n               INNER JOIN issues blocker ON blocker.id = blocker_dep.depends_on_id\n               WHERE blocker_dep.issue_id = i.id\n               AND blocker_dep.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n               AND blocker.status != 'closed'\n           )\n         GROUP BY i.id\n         ORDER BY\n             downstream_impact DESC,\n             critical_path_bonus DESC,\n             i.priority ASC,\n             i.created_at ASC\n         LIMIT ?1\",\n    )?;\n\n    let mut rows = stmt.query(params![limit as i64])?;\n    let mut candidates = Vec::new();\n\n    while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n        candidates.push(ScoredBead {\n            id: row.get(0)?,\n            title: row.get(1)?,\n            status: row.get(2)?,\n            priority: row.get(3)?,\n            downstream_impact: row.get(4)?,\n            critical_float: row.get(5)?,\n            created_at: row.get(6)?,\n        });\n    }\n\n    Ok(candidates)\n}\n\n/// Claim from the highest-priority bead across multiple workspaces.\n///\n/// Scores each workspace's top candidate, picks the global winner,\n/// and claims from that workspace.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// * `workspace_paths` - Slice of workspace directory paths\n/// * `worker` - The worker ID claiming the bead\n/// * `claim_ttl_minutes` - TTL in minutes after which in_progress beads are reclaimed\n/// * `worker_metadata` - Optional worker metadata (model, harness, version)\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// * `Ok(Some(claim_result))` - A bead was claimed (with workspace_path set)\n/// * `Ok(None)` - No beads available to claim in any workspace\n/// * `Err(e)` - Transaction error\npub fn claim_any(\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    worker: &str,\n    claim_ttl_minutes: i64,\n    worker_metadata: Option<&WorkerMetadata>,\n) -> Result<Option<ClaimResult>> {\n    use crate::config::load_metadata;\n    use crate::storage::Storage;\n\n    // Score across all workspaces\n    let mut best: Option<(Score, usize)> = None;\n    for (idx, workspace_path) in workspace_paths.iter().enumerate() {\n        let beads_dir = get_beads_dir(workspace_path)?;\n        let metadata = load_metadata(&beads_dir)?;\n        let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n\n        // Open each workspace's SQLite\n        match Storage::open(&db_path) {\n            Ok(storage) => {\n                if let Some(score) = storage.top_candidate_score()? {\n                    if best.as_ref().map(|(b, _)| score > *b).unwrap_or(true) {\n                        best = Some((score, idx));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Skip workspaces that can't be opened (e.g., no .beads directory)\n                continue;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    match best {\n        None => Ok(None),\n        Some((_, workspace_idx)) => {\n db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            match storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n Some(workspace_path.clone());\n                    Ok(Some(result))\n                }\n                None => Ok(None),\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Get the .beads directory from a workspace path.\n///\n/// If the workspace path itself contains a .beads directory, use it.\n/// Otherwise, assume the path IS the .beads directory.\nfn get_beads_dir(workspace_path: &Path) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf> {\n    let beads_dir = workspace_path.join(\".beads\");\n    if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n        Ok(beads_dir)\n    } else if workspace_path.ends_with(\".beads\") {\n        Ok(workspace_path.to_path_buf())\n    } else {\n        use anyhow::bail;\n        bail!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace_path)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Find all bead workspace directories find_workspaces(start_path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>> {\n\n    let mut workspaces = Vec::new();\n\n    // Start from the given path and search upward\n    let mut current = start_path.to_path_buf();\n    loop {\n        let beads_dir = current.join(\".beads\");\n        if beads_dir.is_dir() {\n            // Found a workspace - add the parent directory\n            workspaces.push(current.clone());\n        }\n\n        // Move to parent directory\n        if !current.pop() {\n            // Reached the root, stop searching\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(workspaces)\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::storage::Storage;\n    use crate::model::{Issue, Status};\n\n    fn setup_test_db() ->
